description: This Dart source file defines an API client for authentication-related operations, including login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset. It also includes an exception class for API errors.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception to surface API error messages, optionally including an HTTP status code.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: Client for interacting with FastAPI authentication endpoints, supporting login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset.

methods.name: ApiException
methods.description: Constructor for ApiException, takes message and optional statusCode.

methods.name: AuthApi
methods.description: Constructor to initialize API client with optional base URL.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri from the base URL and given path.

methods.name: _jsonHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for JSON requests, optionally including Authorization bearer token.

methods.name: _errorMessageFromBody
methods.description: Parses error message from JSON response body.

methods.name: _handleJsonResponse
methods.description: Handles HTTP response, checking status code and decoding JSON, raising ApiException on errors.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON body and handles response.

methods.name: postJsonWithAuth
methods.description: Performs an authenticated POST request, attempting token refresh on 401.

methods.name: loginWithPassword
methods.description: Performs login with phone/email and password via POST request.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Requests OTP for login/signup by phone.

methods.name: signupWithPassword
methods.description: Signs up a new user with phone, email, password, optional name, and consent.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using provided refresh token.

methods.name: passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Requests a password reset for phone or email.

methods.name: passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset with OTP and sets new password.
